stdlib_stats (module)#

Provides a single entry point to the statistical procedures of stdlib: descriptive statistics, random number generation and probability distributions (Specification: stdlib_stats)

See also the specification page: stdlib_stats.

stdlib_stats_descriptive (module)#

Provides support for various statistical methods. This includes currently descriptive statistics (Specification: stdlib_stats_descriptive)
